services.name: Customized Tour Packages
services.short_description: Tailor-made holidays designed around your interests, budget, and travel style.
services.long_description: Whether you're a solo backpacker, a honeymooning couple, or a family of ten — we craft tour packages that match exactly what you're looking for. Tell us your dream destination, your dates, and your budget. We'll handle everything else.

services.name: Hotel Booking
services.short_description: Best rates at handpicked hotels across India and internationally.
services.long_description: With our strong network of hotel partners across India and abroad, we secure the best rates without compromising on quality. From budget stays to 5-star luxury resorts — we've got the right room for you.

services.name: Transportation & Cab Services
services.short_description: Private, comfortable, and reliable transport for every journey.
services.long_description: We provide a variety of vehicle types for rent — from sedans and SUVs to tempo travellers and buses. All our vehicles are air-conditioned, well-maintained, and driven by experienced, licensed drivers.

services.name: Corporate Travel & MICE
services.short_description: End-to-end corporate travel solutions, retreats, and event management.
services.long_description: From corporate offsites to large-scale conferences and incentive travel programs, Shanvi Hospitality handles every detail. We manage logistics, accommodation, activities, and on-ground support so your team can focus on what matters.

services.name: Flight Booking
services.short_description: Affordable domestic and international flight bookings.
services.long_description: Get the best airfares for your travel dates. We search across airlines to find you the most cost-effective flight options, whether you're flying within India or heading abroad.

services.name: Visa Assistance
services.short_description: Hassle-free visa documentation support for international travel.
services.long_description: Planning to travel abroad? We guide you through the visa application process — from document preparation to submission — ensuring your application is complete and submitted correctly.

services.name: Travel Guide Services
services.short_description: Expert local guides to enrich your travel experience.
services.long_description: Explore destinations with knowledgeable, friendly local guides who bring history, culture, and stories to life. Available for sightseeing tours across major destinations in India.

services.name: Service Apartments
services.short_description: Comfortable fully-furnished service apartments for extended stays.
services.long_description: Ideal for long-term business travelers or families who prefer the comfort of a home while traveling. We arrange fully-furnished service apartments in major cities across India.
